title: Fix API-key callers blocked from agent session tools
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG1-01 / F49 (memorysmith-agentsession-apikey-audit-26-07-18-04-32-03)

## Problem
API-key-authenticated callers never get a `ClaimsPrincipal` with `NameIdentifier` or `Identity.Name`, so `RequirePrincipalId()` always returns null, and every `memorysmith_agent_invoke` and `memorysmith_agent_session_end` call is rejected with a misleading error ("requires an authenticated caller"). The API-key path only does authorization (`context.Succeed`), never builds an identity.

## Severity
Medium-High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/AgentSessions/AgentSessionService.cs` lines 660-662
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/SecurityServices.cs` lines 325-335

## Recommendation
Option 1 (cheap): improve error message to indicate API keys can't scope sessions
Option 2 (moderate): assign synthetic principal ID for API-key callers
Option 3 (involved): full authentication handler for API-key scheme

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
